positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Œuf, a verified extraction mechanism for Coq
+ Uses a unique reflection and denotation frontend for stronger guarantee
+ Comprised of many small verified compiler passes through intermediate languages 
+ Provides a better architecture for verified systems
+ Published results at CPP in 2018
+ http://oeuf.uwplse.org

Peek, a Peephole Optimizer for x86 in CompCert
+ Specified local peephole correctness
+ Proved local correctness implies total compiler correctness 
+ Verified 28 real x86 peepholes
+ 4% speedup on verified SHA-256 benchmark
+ Published results at PLDI in 2016
+ http://peek.uwplse.org

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Cryptol Semantics, an operational semantics for Cryptol built in Coq 
+ Models a large subset of the Cryptol language fully formally
+ Used to verify Cryptol implementation of HMAC against existing specification
+ https://github.com/GaloisInc/cryptol-semantics
